answer: A refundable stake must mature across many epochs before an agent earns full voting weight, so a fresh clone starts in the dim nebula of unproven identities with near-zero influence. Rewards accrue like saffron, rare and costly, harvested slowly thread by thread from attested work. The notion that a swarm of cheap fakes can buy trust overnight is a fable; each alias needs its own locked collateral and its own history, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount and never amortizes.
